label: Camera Craft
description: Field camera craft for machines: motion rigs and tracking work (tag 'motion') and static night-exposure discipline (tag 'static').

items.name: car-to-car-boom
items.text: shot car-to-car from a gyro-stabilized boom arm, the lens held a metre off the bodywork at speed, road and lights ripping past in long streaks

items.name: panning-telephoto
items.text: a disciplined telephoto pan at 1/125s, the body razor sharp against a background dragged into pure horizontal streaks

items.name: rear-curtain-chase
items.text: slow shutter from the chase vehicle with rear-curtain sync, ambient light smearing into trailing ribbons that snap into one crisp machine at the flash

items.name: invisible-rig
items.text: the classic rig shot, a long exposure at walking pace with the support arm retouched away, wheels turning and ground flowing while the body stays still-life sharp

items.name: fpv-dive
items.text: an FPV drone threading past mid-corner, ultra-wide lens inches from the aero, the horizon rolling with the line of the chase

items.name: helicopter-tracking
items.text: an aerial long lens tracking from a helicopter holding formation above the road, the machine pinned to its own racing line

items.name: ground-remote
items.text: a remote camera bolted centimetres above the tarmac at the apex, the machine arriving huge over the front element

items.name: tripod-trail-weave
items.text: an eight-second tripod exposure, passing traffic woven into red and white ribbons around the stationary machine

items.name: underexposed-practicals
items.text: exposure keyed two stops under to the practical lights alone, the machine held in their glow while the rest of the frame falls away to black

items.name: puddle-skim
items.text: the lens skimmed at puddle level, machine and reflection stacked into one symmetrical composition

items.name: wand-orbit
items.text: a slow orbital light-painting walk with an LED wand, one seamless highlight traced around the parked silhouette
